normalization_policy: Source anchors normalize long s to s, typographical ligatures, line-wrap word breaks and ordinary spacing; astronomical glyphs may be represented by their conventional English names or Unicode glyphs. Archaic spelling and substantive wording are preserved. Catchwords are not counted twice. No argument, aspect, planet, comparison, number, unit, or apparent contradiction is silently corrected.
